hook.convey: a turn = how much you spin from where you started, not how long anything is; full turn → back to the same view; half turn → facing the opposite way; quarter turn → facing the side; a dancer's spin, a fielder turning to chase the ball, a car's steering

use.hi: Dance mein jab tum ek poora chakkar ghoomte ho, toh wapas usi taraf dekhne lagte ho jahan se shuru kiya tha. Aadha chakkar ghoomo toh theek peeche ki taraf dekhte ho.
use.en: In a dance, when you spin one full turn, you end up looking the same way you started. Spin half a turn and you look straight behind you.

use.hi: Cricket mein fielder batsman ki taraf dekh raha hai, aur ball uske theek peeche boundary ki taraf gayi. Ball ke peeche bhaagne ke liye woh aadha chakkar ghoomkar ulti taraf dekhta hai.
use.en: In cricket a fielder is facing the batsman, and the ball has gone straight behind him towards the boundary. To chase it he makes a half turn and faces the opposite way.

use.hi: Car ka steering kitna ghooma, yeh uske size se nahi, uske ghoomne se pata chalta hai. Chhota steering ho ya bada, quarter turn dono ka ek jaisa hota hai.
use.en: How much a car's steering wheel turned is told by its turning, not its size. A small wheel or a big one, a quarter turn is the same for both.

explain.convey: a full turn as one circle in 4 equal parts; one part swept = a quarter turn = 1/4 of a full turn; facing the board, a quarter turn → facing a side wall; predict how many parts make a half turn

point.hi: Yeh gol ek poora chakkar hai, aur iske 4 barabar hisse hain. Ek hissa bhara hai: itna ghoomna ek quarter turn hai, poore chakkar ka 1/4. Board ki taraf dekhkar ek quarter turn lo, toh tum side wali deewar ki taraf dekhoge.
point.en: This circle is one full turn, and it has 4 equal parts. One part is filled: turning that much is a quarter turn, 1/4 of a full turn. Facing the board, make a quarter turn and you will face the side wall.

prompt.hi: Isi gol mein aadha chakkar dikhana ho, toh kitne hisse bharne padenge?
prompt.en: To show a half turn on this same circle, how many parts must be filled?

why.hi: aadha chakkar poore chakkar ka 2/4 hai, yaani 4 mein se 2 hisse
why.en: a half turn is 2/4 of a full turn, 2 of the 4 parts

simpler.hi: Poore gol ke 4 barabar hisse hain, aur ek hissa jitna ghoomna quarter turn hai. Board se ek quarter turn lo, toh side wali deewar saamne aati hai.
simpler.en: The whole circle has 4 equal parts, and turning one part is a quarter turn. Make a quarter turn from the board and the side wall comes in front.

explain.convey: same circle, 2 of 4 parts swept = 2/4 = half turn → facing the exact opposite way (board → back wall), not the side; 3 parts = three-quarter turn; all 4 = full turn, back to the start

point.hi: Ab 4 mein se 2 hisse bhare hain, yaani 2/4, aadha chakkar. Aadha chakkar ghoomkar tum ulti taraf dekhte ho: board se ghoomkar peeche wali deewar ki taraf, side wali deewar ki taraf nahi. Chaaron hisse ghoomo toh poora chakkar.
point.en: Now 2 of the 4 parts are filled, that is 2/4, a half turn. After a half turn you face the opposite way: from the board round to the back wall, not to a side wall. All four parts make a full turn.

prompt.hi: Tum darwaze ki taraf dekh rahe ho aur aadha chakkar ghoomte ho. Ab darwaza tumhare peeche hoga ya side mein?
prompt.en: You are facing the door and make a half turn. Will the door now be behind you or at your side?

why.hi: aadha chakkar tumhe ulti taraf ghuma deta hai, toh saamne wala darwaza peeche aa jaata hai
why.en: a half turn makes you face the opposite way, so the door in front ends up behind you

simpler.hi: Aadha chakkar matlab 4 mein se 2 hisse ghoomna. Isse tum theek ulti taraf dekhne lagte ho.
simpler.en: A half turn means turning 2 of the 4 parts. It makes you face the exact opposite way.

explain.convey: an angle = the amount of turn between two arms, not the length of the arms; two angles each opened a quarter turn, one with short arms and one with long arms → equal angles; transfer: open the short one wider → it becomes the bigger angle

point.hi: Do angle dekho. Ek ki bhujayein chhoti hain, ek ki lambi, par dono quarter turn khule hain. Angle bhujaon ki lambai nahi hai, angle ghoomne ki maatra hai, isliye yeh dono angle barabar hain.
point.en: Look at two angles. One has short arms and one has long arms, but both are open a quarter turn. An angle is not the length of its arms; an angle is the amount of turn, so these two angles are equal.

prompt.hi: Ab chhoti bhujayon wala angle aadha chakkar khula hai, aur lambi bhujayon wala sirf quarter turn. Kaunsa angle bada hai: chhoti bhujayon wala ya lambi bhujayon wala?
prompt.en: Now the angle with short arms is open a half turn, and the one with long arms only a quarter turn. Which angle is bigger: the short-armed one or the long-armed one?

why.hi: chhoti bhujayon wala angle aadha chakkar khula hai, jo quarter turn ka dugna hai
why.en: the short-armed angle is open a half turn, twice a quarter turn

simpler.hi: Angle mein bhujaon ki lambai nahi dekhte. Angle mein dekhte hain ki kitna ghoomna hua.
simpler.en: For an angle we do not look at how long the arms are. We look at how much turning there is.

problem.hi: Kavya class mein darwaze ki taraf dekh rahi hai. Khidki uske peeche hai, blackboard daayein taraf aur almirah baayein taraf. Kavya pehle aadha chakkar ghoomti hai, phir daayein taraf ek quarter turn leti hai. Ab woh kis taraf dekh rahi hai, aur kul kitna ghoomi?
problem.en: Kavya stands in class facing the door. The window is behind her, the blackboard on her right and the almirah on her left. Kavya first makes a half turn, then a quarter turn to her right. What does she face now, and how much has she turned in all?

givens.hi: shuru mein Kavya darwaze ki taraf dekh rahi hai
givens.en: at the start Kavya faces the door

givens.hi: uske aage darwaza hai, peeche khidki, daayein blackboard aur baayein almirah
givens.en: the door is in front of her, the window behind, the blackboard on the right and the almirah on the left

givens.hi: pehle aadha chakkar, phir daayein taraf ek quarter turn
givens.en: first a half turn, then a quarter turn to the right

find.hi: Kavya aakhir mein kis taraf dekhti hai, aur kul kitna chakkar ghoomi
find.en: what Kavya faces at the end, and her total turn

steps.result: Kavya ab khidki ki taraf dekh rahi hai

why.hi: aadha chakkar ghoomkar hum theek ulti taraf dekhte hain, aur khidki darwaze ke ulti taraf hai
why.en: a half turn makes us face the exact opposite way, and the window is opposite the door

simpler.hi: Aadha chakkar tumhe theek ulti taraf ghuma deta hai. Darwaze ki ulti taraf khidki hai, toh Kavya ab khidki dekhti hai.
simpler.en: A half turn makes you face the exact opposite way. The window is opposite the door, so Kavya now sees the window.

do.hi: Ab daayein taraf ek quarter turn lo
do.en: Now make a quarter turn to the right

steps.result: Kavya ab almirah ki taraf dekh rahi hai

why.hi: khidki ki taraf muh karne par uska daayan haath almirah ki taraf hota hai
why.en: when she faces the window, her right hand points to the almirah

simpler.hi: Kavya ab khidki ki taraf muh kiye khadi hai. Tab uska daayan haath almirah ki taraf hai, toh daayein quarter turn se almirah saamne aati hai.
simpler.en: Kavya now faces the window. Then her right hand points to the almirah, so a quarter turn to the right brings the almirah in front.

prompt.hi: Aadha chakkar 2 quarter turn hai, aur phir ek quarter turn aur liya. Kavya kul kitna chakkar ghoomi?
prompt.en: A half turn is 2 quarter turns, and then one more quarter turn was made. How much has Kavya turned in all?

simpler.hi: Aadha chakkar 2 quarter turn hai, aur uske baad ek quarter turn aur liya. Ab saare quarter turn jodkar gino.
simpler.en: A half turn is 2 quarter turns, and after that one more quarter turn was made. Now add up all the quarter turns.

answer.hi: Kavya almirah ki taraf dekh rahi hai aur kul 3/4 chakkar, yaani teen-chauthai chakkar ghoomi hai
answer.en: Kavya faces the almirah and has turned a 3/4 turn in all, a three-quarter turn

why.hi: aadha chakkar 2 quarter turn hai, ek aur quarter juda, toh poore chakkar ke 4 mein se 3 quarter hue
why.en: a half turn is 2 quarter turns plus one more quarter, so it is 3 of a full turn's 4 quarters

prompt.hi: Cycle ke pahiye par ek laal nishaan pehle sabse upar hai. Pahiya aadha chakkar ghoomta hai. Ab nishaan kahaan hai: sabse neeche ya ek side mein?
prompt.en: A red mark on a bicycle wheel is at the very top. The wheel makes a half turn. Where is the mark now: at the very bottom or at one side?

why.hi: aadha chakkar nishaan ko ulti taraf le jaata hai, sabse upar se sabse neeche
why.en: a half turn takes the mark to the opposite side, from the very top to the very bottom

simpler.hi: Aadha chakkar kisi bhi cheez ko theek ulti taraf le jaata hai. Sabse upar ki ulti taraf socho.
simpler.en: A half turn takes anything to the exact opposite side. Think of the opposite of the very top.

prompt.hi: Haath ke do pankhe hain, ek chhota pankha aur ek bada pankha. Dono theek quarter turn khule hain. Kiska angle bada hai: chhote ka, bade ka, ya dono barabar?
prompt.en: There are two hand fans, a small one and a big one. Both are open exactly a quarter turn. Whose angle is bigger: the small one's, the big one's, or are both equal?

why.hi: dono pankhe theek quarter turn khule hain, aur pankhe ka size angle nahi badalta
why.en: both fans are open exactly a quarter turn, and a fan's size does not change its angle

simpler.hi: Pankhe ka angle uske size se nahi, uske khulne se banta hai. Dekho dono pankhe kitna khule hain.
simpler.en: A fan's angle comes from how far it opens, not from its size. See how far each fan is open.

ladder.why: how many quarter turns make a half turn → the e1 ask on its own, no picture
a mark on a bicycle wheel, top → right side → name the part of a full turn (a quarter)
giant wheel half turn → top seat goes to the bottom, not the side; the half-is-quarter trap in a new object
big scissors opened a little vs small scissors opened wide → angle = opening, not blade length
three-quarter turn then a quarter turn the same way → add the quarters → one full turn

remediation.move: a circle on the floor in 4 quarters, board in front, side walls, back wall; step through the quarters saying 'ek quarter, do quarter'; one quarter → side wall, two quarters → back wall; the half turn = 2 quarters

say.hi: Farsh par ek gol socho, 4 barabar hisson mein. Ek quarter ghoomo toh side ki deewar dikhti hai, do quarter ghoomo toh peeche ki deewar. Aadha chakkar matlab 2 quarter, yaani 2/4.
say.en: Picture a circle on the floor in 4 equal parts. Turn one quarter and you see the side wall; turn two quarters and you see the back wall. A half turn means 2 quarters, that is 2/4.

simpler.hi: Farsh par gol ke 4 barabar hisse socho. Do quarter ghoomo toh peeche ki deewar dikhti hai. Aadha chakkar matlab 2 quarter, yaani 2/4.
simpler.en: Picture a floor circle in 4 equal parts. Turn two quarters and you face the back wall. A half turn means 2 quarters, that is 2/4.

prompt.hi: Pehle tum TV ki taraf dekh rahe ho, phir aadha chakkar ghoomte ho. Ab TV kahaan hai: peeche ya side mein?
prompt.en: You are facing the TV and make a half turn. Where is the TV now: behind you or at your side?

why.hi: aadha chakkar ghoomkar tum ulti taraf dekhte ho, toh TV peeche ho jaata hai
why.en: after a half turn you face the opposite way, so the TV is behind you

simpler.hi: Aadha chakkar tumhe theek ulti taraf ghuma deta hai. Socho TV ab kis taraf hoga.
simpler.en: A half turn makes you face the exact opposite way. Think where the TV will be now.

remediation.move: two paper fans opened the same amount, one small and one big, laid on top of each other at the hinge; the arms point the same way → the same angle, whatever the arm length

say.hi: Do kaagaz ke pankhe socho, ek chhota pankha aur ek bada pankha, dono utne hi khule. Chhote pankhe ko bade ke upar kone se milao: dono ki bhujayein ek hi taraf jaati hain, isliye angle barabar hai.
say.en: Picture two paper fans, a small one and a big one, both open the same amount. Lay the small fan on the big one, corner on corner: the arms of both point the same way, so the angle is the same.

simpler.hi: Chhota pankha aur bada pankha, dono utne hi khule. Kone par kona rakho: bhujayein ek hi taraf jaati hain, toh angle barabar hai.
simpler.en: A small fan and a big fan, open the same amount. Put corner on corner: the arms point the same way, so the angle is the same.

prompt.hi: Badi ghadi aur chhoti ghadi, dono ki minute ki sui 12 se 3 tak gayi. Kiski sui zyada ghoomi: badi, chhoti, ya barabar?
prompt.en: On a big clock and a small clock the minute hand went from 12 to 3. Whose turned more: big, small, or the same?

why.hi: dono suiyan 12 se 3 tak gayin, yaani dono ne ek hi quarter turn liya
why.en: both hands went from 12 to 3, so both made the same quarter turn

simpler.hi: Sui kitna ghoomi, yeh ghadi ke size se nahi badalta. Dono suiyan 12 se 3 tak hi gayi hain.
simpler.en: How far a hand turns does not depend on the clock's size. Both hands went from 12 to 3.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab tak humne dekha ki kitna ghoome: quarter turn ya aadha chakkar. Agle hisse mein dekhenge ki kis taraf ghoome: ghadi ki suiyon wali taraf, ya ulti taraf.
bridgeToNext.en: So far we saw how much we turn: a quarter turn or a half turn. Next we will see which way we turn: the way the clock hands go, or the other way.

hook.convey: a turn also has a direction: the way the clock hands move = clockwise, the other way = anticlockwise; stirring a pot, a dance teacher's instruction

use.hi: Kitchen mein kadhai mein chamach chalate waqt tum ya toh ghadi ki suiyon ki taraf ghumate ho, ya ulti taraf. Pehli taraf clockwise hai, doosri anticlockwise.
use.en: In the kitchen, when you stir a pan with a spoon, you either go the way the clock hands go, or the other way. The first way is clockwise, the second anticlockwise.

use.hi: Dance class mein teacher bolti hain 'clockwise ghoomo', toh sabko ghadi ki suiyon wali taraf ghoomna hai. Koi ulti taraf ghooma, toh woh doosre se takra jaayega.
use.en: In dance class the teacher says 'turn clockwise', so everyone has to turn the way the clock hands go. Anyone who turns the other way will bump into someone.

explain.convey: clockwise = the way the hands move: 12 → 3 → 6; anticlockwise = the other way: 12 → 9 → 6; transfer: 6 → 9 is still clockwise (the hand's own way), even though 9 sits on the anticlockwise side from 12

mustSay.en: the way the clock hands go

point.hi: Ghadi ki sui 12 se 3 ki taraf, phir 3 se 6 ki taraf jaati hai: yeh ghadi ki suiyon wali taraf hai, clockwise. Ulti taraf, 12 se 9 aur 9 se 6, anticlockwise hai.
point.en: A clock hand goes from 12 towards 3, then from 3 towards 6: this is the way the clock hands go, clockwise. The other way, 12 to 9 and 9 to 6, is anticlockwise.

prompt.hi: Sui 6 se 7, 8 hote hue 9 tak jaati hai. Yeh clockwise hai ya anticlockwise?
prompt.en: A hand goes from 6 through 7 and 8 to 9. Is that clockwise or anticlockwise?

why.hi: sui 6 se badhte numberon 7, 8 hote hue 9 tak gayi, jaise ghadi ki suiyan chalti hain
why.en: the hand went from 6 up through 7 and 8 to 9, the way clock hands move

simpler.hi: Ghadi ki suiyan 12 se 3, phir 3 se 6 ki taraf chalti hain. Ulti taraf, 12 se 9 ki taraf chalna anticlockwise hai.
simpler.en: Clock hands go from 12 to 3, then from 3 to 6. Going the other way, from 12 towards 9, is anticlockwise.

explain.convey: following a turn instruction from 12: quarter turn clockwise → 3, quarter turn anticlockwise → 9; half turn either way → 6; a quarter turn moves the hand 3 numbers on, in the named direction; transfer from a start that is not 12

point.hi: Sui 12 par hai. Quarter turn clockwise lo toh sui 3 par rukti hai, aur quarter turn anticlockwise lo toh 9 par. Har quarter turn mein sui 3 number aage jaati hai, bataayi gayi taraf mein. Aadha chakkar kisi bhi taraf lo, sui 6 par hi pahunchti hai.
point.en: The hand is at 12. A quarter turn clockwise stops it at 3, and a quarter turn anticlockwise stops it at 9. In every quarter turn the hand moves 3 numbers on, in the direction named. A half turn either way brings it to 6.

prompt.hi: Sui 2 par hai aur quarter turn clockwise ghoomti hai. Sui kis number par rukegi?
prompt.en: The hand is at 2 and makes a quarter turn clockwise. At which number does it stop?

why.hi: 2 se clockwise 3, 4, 5 teen number aage hain, ek quarter turn
why.en: clockwise from 2, the numbers 3, 4, 5 are three numbers on, one quarter turn

simpler.hi: Ek quarter turn mein sui 3 number aage jaati hai. Jaise 12 se clockwise quarter turn lo, toh sui 3 par aati hai.
simpler.en: In one quarter turn the hand moves 3 numbers on. Like a quarter turn clockwise from 12 brings the hand to 3.

explain.convey: three-quarter turn one way ends where a quarter turn the other way ends: 3 of 4 parts swept clockwise → the 1 part left over is the short way back, anticlockwise

point.hi: Is gol ke 4 mein se 3 hisse bhare hain: yeh 3/4, yaani teen-chauthai chakkar clockwise hai. Jo ek hissa khaali bacha hai, use dekho: wahi jagah ulti taraf se sirf ek quarter turn mein aa jaati hai.
point.en: 3 of the 4 parts of this circle are filled: this is 3/4, a three-quarter turn clockwise. Look at the one part left empty: the same place is reached the other way in just one quarter turn.

prompt.hi: Ek robot teen-chauthai chakkar anticlockwise ghoomta hai. Clockwise kitne quarter turn lekar woh usi taraf muh kar lega?
prompt.en: A robot makes a three-quarter turn anticlockwise. How many quarter turns clockwise would make it face the same way?

why.hi: teen-chauthai chakkar anticlockwise ke baad poore chakkar ka sirf 1/4 bachta hai, jo clockwise 1 quarter turn hai
why.en: three quarters anticlockwise leaves just 1/4 of the full turn, which is 1 quarter turn clockwise

simpler.hi: Gol ke 4 mein se 3 hisse bhare hain, aur ek hissa khaali hai. Ulti taraf se wahi jagah bas khaali hisse jitna ghoomkar aa jaati hai.
simpler.en: 3 of the 4 parts of the circle are filled, and one part is empty. The other way, the same place comes after turning just the empty part.

problem.hi: Ghadi jaise dial par sui 12 par hai. Card par likha hai: pehle aadha chakkar clockwise, phir quarter turn anticlockwise. Sui kis number par rukegi?
problem.en: On a dial marked like a clock, the pointer is at 12. The card says: first a half turn clockwise, then a quarter turn anticlockwise. At which number does the pointer stop?

givens.en: at the start the pointer is at 12

givens.hi: pehla turn aadha chakkar clockwise hai
givens.en: turn 1 is a half turn clockwise

givens.hi: doosra turn quarter turn anticlockwise hai
givens.en: turn 2 is a quarter turn anticlockwise

find.hi: sui aakhir mein kis number par rukti hai
find.en: the number where the pointer finally stops

do.hi: Pehle aadha chakkar clockwise lo, 12 se 3 hote hue aage
do.en: First make the half turn clockwise, from 12 on past 3

why.hi: clockwise ghadi ki suiyon wali taraf hai, aur aadha chakkar sui ko theek ulti taraf le jaata hai
why.en: clockwise is the way the clock hands go, and a half turn takes the pointer to the exact opposite side

simpler.hi: Clockwise matlab ghadi ki suiyon wali taraf. Aadha chakkar sui ko 12 se theek saamne 6 par le jaata hai.
simpler.en: Clockwise means the way the clock hands go. A half turn takes the pointer from 12 to 6, right opposite.

do.hi: Ab 6 se anticlockwise ki taraf pehchaano
do.en: Now find the anticlockwise way from 6

steps.result: sui 6 se 5 aur 4 ki taraf chalegi

why.hi: anticlockwise ghadi ki suiyon ki ulti taraf hai
why.en: anticlockwise is the opposite of the way the clock hands go

simpler.hi: Anticlockwise matlab suiyon ki ulti taraf. 6 se ulti taraf chalo, toh pehle 5 aata hai, phir 4.
simpler.en: Anticlockwise means the opposite of the way the hands go. Going that way from 6, you meet 5 first, then 4.

prompt.hi: Ab 6 se ek quarter turn anticlockwise lo, yaani teen number ulti taraf. Sui kis number par rukegi?
prompt.en: Now make one quarter turn anticlockwise from 6, that is three numbers the other way. At which number does the pointer stop?

simpler.hi: 6 se ulti taraf teen number gino. Pehle 5, phir 4, aur phir ek aur.
simpler.en: Count three numbers back from 6. First 5, then 4, and then one more.

answer.hi: sui 3 par rukti hai, jo 12 se seedha ek quarter turn clockwise jaisa hai
answer.en: the pointer stops at 3, the same as one quarter turn clockwise straight from 12

why.hi: aadha chakkar clockwise mein se ek quarter wapas anticlockwise aaya, toh clockwise sirf ek quarter bacha
why.en: of the half turn clockwise, one quarter came back anticlockwise, so only one quarter clockwise is left

prompt.hi: Shuru mein sui 4 par hai. Woh quarter turn anticlockwise ghoomti hai. Sui kis number par rukegi?
prompt.en: At the start the hand is at 4. It makes a quarter turn anticlockwise. At which number does it stop?

why.hi: 4 se anticlockwise 3, 2, 1 teen number peeche hain, ek quarter turn
why.en: anticlockwise from 4, the numbers 3, 2, 1 are three numbers back, one quarter turn

simpler.hi: Anticlockwise mein sui 4 se chhote numberon ki taraf chalti hai. Ek quarter turn mein teen number peeche gino.
simpler.en: Anticlockwise, the hand goes from 4 towards the smaller numbers. For one quarter turn, count three numbers back.

prompt.hi: Ghadi ki sui ka raasta 9 se 10, 11 hote hue 12 tak hai. Yeh clockwise hai ya anticlockwise?
prompt.en: A clock hand goes from 9 through 10 and 11 to 12. Is that clockwise or anticlockwise?

why.hi: sui 9 se badhte numberon 10, 11 hote hue 12 tak gayi, ghadi ki suiyon wali taraf
why.en: the hand went from 9 up through 10 and 11 to 12, the way clock hands go

simpler.hi: Dekho number badh rahe hain ya ghat rahe hain: 9, 10, 11, 12. Ghadi ki suiyan bhi badhte numberon ki taraf chalti hain.
simpler.en: See whether the numbers go up or down: 9, 10, 11, 12. Clock hands also move towards bigger numbers.

ladder.why: a metro arrow from north to west by the shorter turn → name the direction (anticlockwise)
12 to 9 clockwise → three quarters, not one; direction decides the amount
predict: two quarter turns clockwise → facing the opposite way
two instructions in a row (quarter clockwise, half anticlockwise) → follow each from the new direction
three-quarter clockwise = one quarter anticlockwise (e3) in a dance step

remediation.move: a real clock face with an arrow along the hands' path; the child traces the path with a finger 12 → 1 → 2 → 3, then turns their own body the same way; the other way 12 → 11 → 10 → 9 = anticlockwise

say.hi: Ghadi par ungli rakho aur sui ke raaste par chalao: 12 se 1, 2, 3 ki taraf. Yahi clockwise hai. Ungli 12 se 11, 10, 9 ki taraf chale, toh woh anticlockwise hai.
say.en: Put a finger on the clock and move it along the hand's path: from 12 towards 1, 2, 3. That is clockwise. If the finger goes from 12 towards 11, 10, 9, that is anticlockwise.

simpler.hi: Sui ke raaste chalo: 12 se 1, 2, 3 ki taraf, yeh clockwise hai. 12 se 11, 10, 9 ki taraf ulta, yeh anticlockwise hai.
simpler.en: Follow the hand's path: 12 towards 1, 2, 3 is clockwise. 12 towards 11, 10, 9, the other way, is anticlockwise.

prompt.hi: Shuru mein sui 5 par hai. Woh quarter turn clockwise ghoomti hai. Sui kis number par rukegi?
prompt.en: At the start the hand is at 5. It makes a quarter turn clockwise. At which number does it stop?

why.hi: 5 se clockwise 6, 7, 8 teen number aage hain, ek quarter turn
why.en: clockwise from 5, the numbers 6, 7, 8 are three numbers on, one quarter turn

simpler.hi: Ek quarter turn clockwise matlab teen number aage. 5 se aage teen number gino.
simpler.en: One quarter turn clockwise means three numbers on. Count three numbers on from 5.

bridgeToNext.hi: Har quarter turn mein ghadi ki sui 3 number aage jaati hai. Agle hisse mein dekhenge ki ek quarter turn ek right angle hota hai.
bridgeToNext.en: In every quarter turn the clock hand moves 3 numbers on. Next we will see that one quarter turn is one right angle.

hook.convey: the minute hand is a turn-meter: 12 to 3 = 15 minutes = a quarter turn = one right angle; 12 to 6 = 30 minutes = half a turn

use.hi: IPL match se pehle 15 minute ka break hai. Us break mein minute ki sui 12 se 3 tak ghoomti hai, yaani ek quarter turn.
use.en: Before an IPL match there is a 15-minute break. In that break the minute hand turns from 12 to 3, that is one quarter turn.

use.hi: Cake oven mein 30 minute pakta hai. Itni der mein minute ki sui 12 se 6 tak ghoomti hai, yaani aadha chakkar.
use.en: A cake bakes in the oven for 30 minutes. In that time the minute hand turns from 12 to 6, that is half a turn.

explain.convey: a clock face as one full turn in 4 equal quarters: 12 to 3, 3 to 6, 6 to 9, 9 to 12; each quarter = 3 of the 12 numbers = 1/4 of the way round = a quarter turn; transfer: 6 to 12 = two quarters = a half turn

point.hi: Ghadi ka gol 4 barabar hisson mein bata hai: 12 se 3, 3 se 6, 6 se 9, aur 9 se 12. Har hisse mein 3 number ka faasla hai. Sui 12 se 3 tak jaaye toh ek hissa ghoomti hai, yaani 1/4 chakkar, ek quarter turn.
point.en: The clock face is split into 4 equal parts: 12 to 3, 3 to 6, 6 to 9, and 9 to 12. Each part spans 3 numbers. When the hand goes from 12 to 3 it turns one part, that is 1/4 of a turn, a quarter turn.

prompt.hi: Minute ki sui 6 se 12 tak clockwise jaati hai. Yeh kaunsa turn hai: quarter turn ya aadha chakkar?
prompt.en: The minute hand goes clockwise from 6 to 12. Which turn is that: a quarter turn or a half turn?

why.hi: 6 se 12 tak clockwise do quarter hain, 6 se 9 aur 9 se 12, yaani aadha chakkar
why.en: 6 to 12 clockwise is two quarters, 6 to 9 and 9 to 12, a half turn

simpler.hi: Ghadi ke gol ke 4 barabar hisse hain, har hisse mein 3 number. Sui 12 se 3 tak jaaye, toh ek hissa ghoomi, yaani quarter turn.
simpler.en: The clock face has 4 equal parts, with 3 numbers in each. When the hand goes from 12 to 3, it turns one part, a quarter turn.

explain.convey: a quarter turn makes a square corner = one right angle (the corner of a square); the hands at 12 and 3 make that same corner; so 1 quarter turn = 1 right angle, a half turn = 2, a full turn = 4

point.hi: Is square ke har kone par ek right angle hai. Sui 12 se 3 tak ghoome, toh sui ki pehli jagah aur nayi jagah ke beech bhi square ke kone jaisa kona banta hai. Isliye ek quarter turn ek right angle hota hai.
point.en: Every corner of this square is a right angle. When the hand turns from 12 to 3, the corner between where the hand was and where it is now is just like the corner of a square. So one quarter turn is one right angle.

prompt.hi: Sui 12 se 6 tak clockwise ghoomti hai. Woh kitne right angle ghoomi?
prompt.en: The hand turns clockwise from 12 to 6. How many right angles has it turned?

why.hi: 12 se 3 ek right angle hai aur 3 se 6 doosra, yaani 2 right angle
why.en: 12 to 3 is one right angle and 3 to 6 is another, so 2 right angles

simpler.hi: Square ka har kona right angle hai. Sui 12 se 3 tak ghoome toh waisa hi kona banta hai, isliye quarter turn ek right angle hai.
simpler.en: Every corner of a square is a right angle. A hand turning from 12 to 3 makes the same corner, so a quarter turn is one right angle.

problem.hi: Minute ki sui 12 se chalkar clockwise 9 tak jaati hai. Yeh kaunsa turn hai?
problem.en: The minute hand starts at 12 and turns clockwise to 9. What turn is that?

find.hi: yeh poore chakkar ka kitna hissa hai, yaani kaunsa turn
find.en: what part of a full turn this is, that is, which turn

do.hi: Ghadi ke gol ko quarter mein baanto: 12 se 3, 3 se 6, 6 se 9, 9 se 12
do.en: Split the clock face into quarters: 12 to 3, 3 to 6, 6 to 9, 9 to 12

why.hi: poora chakkar saare 12 number paar karta hai, aur 12 ke 4 barabar hisse 3-3 number ke hote hain
why.en: a full turn passes all 12 numbers, and 12 in 4 equal parts is 3 numbers each

simpler.hi: Gol ko 12 se 3, 3 se 6, 6 se 9 aur 9 se 12 mein baanto. 4 barabar quarter bante hain, har ek mein 3 number.
simpler.en: Split the circle into 12 to 3, 3 to 6, 6 to 9 and 9 to 12. That makes 4 equal quarters, with 3 numbers each.

do.hi: Ab 12 se 9 tak clockwise sui ke quarter gino
do.en: Now count the quarters from 12 to 9 clockwise

why.hi: clockwise sui 12 se pehle 3 ki taraf jaati hai, aur 9 par teesra quarter poora hota hai
why.en: clockwise the hand goes from 12 towards 3 first, and the third quarter ends at 9

simpler.hi: Clockwise sui 12 se pehle 3 tak, phir 6 tak, phir 9 tak jaati hai. Har ek hissa ek quarter hai, toh teen quarter hue.
simpler.en: Clockwise the hand goes from 12 to 3, then to 6, then to 9. Each piece is one quarter, so that is three quarters.

prompt.hi: Poore chakkar ke 4 quarter mein se sui ne 3 quarter ghoome. Yeh kaunsa turn hua?
prompt.en: Of the 4 quarters of a full turn, the hand turned 3. Which turn is that?

simpler.hi: Poore chakkar mein 4 quarter hote hain. Jitne quarter ghoome woh upar likho, aur 4 neeche.
simpler.en: A full turn has 4 quarters. Write the quarters turned on top, and 4 at the bottom.

answer.hi: 12 se 9 tak clockwise sui ne 3/4 chakkar, yaani teen-chauthai turn liya
answer.en: from 12 to 9 clockwise the hand made a 3/4 turn, a three-quarter turn

why.hi: poora chakkar 4 quarter ka hai aur sui ne unme se 3 quarter paar kiye, yaani 3 right angle
why.en: a full turn is 4 quarters and the hand passed 3 of them, that is 3 right angles

prompt.hi: Minute ki sui 3 se 9 tak clockwise jaati hai. Woh kitne right angle ghoomi?
prompt.en: The minute hand goes clockwise from 3 to 9. How many right angles has it turned?

why.hi: 3 se 6 ek right angle hai aur 6 se 9 doosra, yaani 2 right angle
why.en: 3 to 6 is one right angle and 6 to 9 is another, so 2 right angles

simpler.hi: Ek right angle matlab ek quarter turn, yaani teen number. 3 se 9 tak teen-teen number ke hisse gino.
simpler.en: One right angle is one quarter turn, that is three numbers. Count the three-number steps from 3 to 9.

prompt.hi: Shuru mein sui 12 par hai. Woh ek right angle anticlockwise ghoomti hai. Sui kis number par rukegi?
prompt.en: At the start the hand is at 12. It turns one right angle anticlockwise. At which number does it stop?

why.hi: ek right angle ek quarter turn hai, aur 12 se anticlockwise 11, 10, 9 teen number peeche hain
why.en: one right angle is one quarter turn, and anticlockwise from 12 the numbers 11, 10, 9 are three back

simpler.hi: Ek right angle ek quarter turn hai, yaani teen number. 12 se ulti taraf teen number gino.
simpler.en: One right angle is one quarter turn, that is three numbers. Count three numbers back the other way from 12.

ladder.why: 12 to 6 → the opposite side → a half turn (e1's transfer, now on its own)
why 12 to 3 is a quarter turn: 3 of the 12 numbers = one quarter of the way round
three-quarter turn anticlockwise from 12 → 9, 6, 3 → ends at 3; amount and direction together
1 to 10 clockwise = 9 number-gaps = 3 quarter turns = 3 right angles; a start that is not 12

remediation.move: the clock face in 4 quarters, stepping through them aloud 'ek quarter, do quarter': 12 to 3 = one quarter = one right angle; 12 to 6 = two quarters = 2/4 = a half turn = two right angles

say.hi: Ghadi ko 4 quarter mein socho. 12 se 3 ek quarter hai, ek right angle. 12 se 6 do quarter hain, yaani 2/4, aadha chakkar, 2 right angle.
say.en: Think of the clock in 4 quarters. 12 to 3 is one quarter, one right angle. 12 to 6 is two quarters, that is 2/4, a half turn, 2 right angles.

simpler.hi: Ghadi ke 4 quarter socho. 12 se 3 ek right angle hai. 12 se 6 do quarter, yaani aadha chakkar, 2 right angle.
simpler.en: Think of the clock in 4 quarters. 12 to 3 is one right angle. 12 to 6 is two quarters, a half turn, 2 right angles.

prompt.hi: Sui 1 se 7 tak clockwise jaati hai. Yeh kaunsa turn hai: quarter turn ya aadha chakkar?
prompt.en: The hand goes clockwise from 1 to 7. Which turn is that: a quarter turn or a half turn?

why.hi: 1 se 7 tak 6 number hain, yaani 3-3 number ke do quarter, aadha chakkar
why.en: 1 to 7 is 6 numbers, two quarters of 3 numbers each, a half turn

simpler.hi: Ek quarter turn mein sui teen number chalti hai. 1 se 7 tak kitne number aage gaye, woh gino.
simpler.en: In a quarter turn the hand moves three numbers. Count how many numbers on it went from 1 to 7.

remediation.move: a real clock face, the finger tracing the hand's own path 12 → 1 → 2 → 3 = clockwise; the other way 12 → 11 → 10 → 9 = anticlockwise; then a right angle each way from 12 lands on 3 or on 9

say.hi: Ungli ghadi par sui ke raaste chalao: 12 se 1, 2, 3. Yeh clockwise hai. 12 se 11, 10, 9 ki taraf ulti chaal anticlockwise hai.
say.en: Move a finger on the clock along the hand's path: 12 to 1, 2, 3. That is clockwise. The other way, from 12 towards 11, 10, 9, is anticlockwise.

simpler.hi: 12 se 1, 2, 3 ki taraf chalna clockwise hai. 12 se 11, 10, 9 ki taraf ulta chalna anticlockwise hai.
simpler.en: Going from 12 towards 1, 2, 3 is clockwise. Going the other way, from 12 towards 11, 10, 9, is anticlockwise.

prompt.hi: Shuru mein sui 4 par hai. Woh ek right angle clockwise ghoomti hai. Sui kis number par rukegi?
prompt.en: At the start the hand is at 4. It turns one right angle clockwise. At which number does it stop?

why.hi: ek right angle ek quarter turn hai, aur 4 se clockwise 5, 6, 7 teen number aage hain
why.en: one right angle is one quarter turn, and clockwise from 4 the numbers 5, 6, 7 are three on

simpler.hi: Ek right angle ek quarter turn hai, yaani teen number. 4 se clockwise teen number aage jao.
simpler.en: One right angle is one quarter turn, that is three numbers. Move three numbers on clockwise from 4.
